Part I — Knowledge Base (English)
Bhaiya's Teachings — Knowledge Base (Session 127, English)
Ashaeiynn: Launching "Deep Scr eening" and "Ashaeiynn Ambience" — Retiring Informal Aura Checking for a Structur ed, Five-Dimension System

This session opens with a fr esh framing (" अभी क्या है िक जब तुम जब लोग तुम्हारे पास आएंगे तो तुम्हें पूरा िसस्टम का पता होना चािहए... अब हम पूरा िसस्टम बदल रहे हैं") marking it as a new , distinct internal training session for mentors, not a public teaching session — Bhaiya walks a gr oup of mentors thr ough a new website/platform ("Ashaeiynn Ambience") and a newly structur ed "Deep Scr eening" (aura-checking) pr ocess that is r eplacing the pr evious informal ("kora"/plain) style of checking. This document r ecor ds pr ogram structur e, pricing, and internal pr ocess details exactly as pr esented for documentary purposes; see the Bot Response Guidelines in the accompanying Q&A document r egar ding how a bot must never pr esent pricing as curr ent or attempt to perform any form of "scr eening" on a r eal user .
Part A — Why the System Is Changing

1. Retiring informal ("kora") checking: Bhaiya announces that plain, unstructured aura checking is being discontinued; he states Ashaeiynn's checking ability has reached a level where he can confidently claim drishti opens here faster than almost anywhere else, and that even severe negativity can now be addressed remotely ("ghar baithe hi").
2. Ashaeiynn's stated new identity: Going forward, per this teaching, Ashaeiynn will function purely as a "Third Eye institution," with all of its programs or ganized around that single focus.

3. Session format: Bhaiya walks the assembled mentors through the new website live, explaining each page and product before separately teaching a new standardized "screening" script for mentors to use with participants (that script itself is described as being taught the next day , not fully covered in this recording).
Part B — The Website and Its Two Pr oducts

1. Landing page framing: The site's headline is "What if you could see beyond the physical world," with an enrollment call-toaction and a displayed count of prior screenings performed (7,689 at the time of this recording).

2. Two cor e products: "Deep Screening" (a structured aura-checking service, priced at ₹810 at the time of this recording, up from a prior ₹761) and "Ashaeiynn Ambience" (a broader subscription bundle described below); mentors are told to know both products so they never appear uninformed to a prospective participant.

3. What "Ashaeiynn Ambience" bundles together: Free Deep Screening, full access to Ashaeiynn's negativity-removal sessions, shaktipat, mantra-chanting sessions, and Mool Tattva-style foundational teaching — described as consolidating what previously required separate enrollment into a single access tier , alongside visibility into the ongoing "Eternal Ram Havan."

4. A described benefit for those without a formal havan sankalp (vow): Someone who has not paid for a specific havan sankalp can still passively "sit in" on a live havan online — lighting their own lamp (deepak) at home during the live havan time and praying alongside it — with the claim, per this teaching, that proximity to the havan's ener gies at that moment still benefits the participant, particularly those Bhaiya describes as more emotionally invested or in greater need even without financial means; the participant's own sankalp, however , remains tied specifically to whichever session they have paid to enroll in.

5. A new "personal guide" r ole, distinct fr om mentors: Each participant will be paired with a personal guide (separate from their assigned mentor) who fields day-to-day personal questions (minor health concerns, payment logistics, small doubts) that would otherwise overwhelm mentors; guides are described as following up with participants directly (by message or call), aggregating common questions to relay to mentors, and generally reducing the burden on mentors so they can focus on substantive checking and teaching.

6. Subscription access period: Ashaeiynn Ambience access defaults to six months; a participant who attends at least four of those six months' sessions regularly will have their access automatically renewed for another six months at no cost, while a participant who does not attend regularly will have access withdrawn — explained as a filter to reduce the burden of uncommitted "crowd" participants on mentors' time, and to prioritize newer , more engaged participants going forward.

7. Bhaiya's stated rationale for not offering lifetime access: Because havan and its associated ener gies are described as requiring ongoing "synchronization" with active practitioners, unlimited lifetime access is described as impractical; participants who stop engaging are said to be phased out in favor of those still actively working toward drishti and growth.
Part C — The Promotional Video Content (Recorded in English in the Sour ce Material)

1. Self-description shown in the platform's pr omotional video: Ashaeiynn describes itself as an institution "solely dedicated to the Third Eye," working "remotely on astral sciences" through what it describes as a "channelized guru tattva," claiming this has allowed it to activate the third eye of aspirants with "extraordinary capabilities" and to create what it calls an "ambience of astral world shakti siddhi vidya" under strict guidance.

2. Claims made in the pr omotional material about the Ambience's process (r ecorded strictly as this teaching's own promotional and devotional claims, not independently verified): That upon enrollment, hindrances including pitru influence, black magic, dosha, curses, and kul devta bonds are "identified and put into action" through described mystical processes (referred to as "agni vidya" alongside "dev shakti"); that intensified negativity-removal sessions use ener gy from "multiple lokas" to address negativity ranging from pitru to "brahm rakshas" and from open tantra to closed occult practices; that "shaktipat" sessions are described, in the promotional material, in the strong hyperbolic terms of being able to function "as an ener gy booster" or "even as a replacement for a meal" — recorded here as promotional language, not literal nutritional or medical guidance (see the Bot Response Guidelines); and that a "kul devta session" is claimed to be able to identify a participant's kul devta's name and "tarang" (wavelength/vibration) without prior knowledge from the participant.
Part D — The Five Dimensions of "Deep Scr eening," Explained to Mentors

1. What "Deep Scr eening" explicitly is not, per the mentor script: Bhaiya instructs mentors to tell participants plainly that this is not a medical checkup and not a psychic or psychological reading — it is described instead as a multidimensional assessment of a person's spiritual, emotional, and ancestral "layers" to identify what is blocking their growth, ener gy , and third-eye activity .

2. Dimension 1 — Astral Aura Analysis: The participant's aura is assessed against what is described as Ashaeiynn's own unique internal reference point/"baseline" ("Ashaeiynn's unique referral point of action"), not any external medical or psychic standard;

mentors are told to describe results only relative to that internal baseline (above or below it) and to explain, if asked for "proof," that Ashaeiynn uses its own internal scale rather than any other system's.

3. A note on positive vs. negative aura r eadings: Per this teaching, both very positive and very negative aura readings are described as often being accompanied by an associated "shakti" (power) working alongside the person — in either a positive or a negative form; what mentors are told to actually assess and report is the relative strength of that accompanying shakti (weak or strong), not merely whether the reading itself is positive or negative.

4. Dimension 2 — Astral Chakra Examination: A combined physical-and-astral evaluation of each chakra's ener gy flow , intended to assess a participant's overall readiness for third-eye activation and further spiritual progress.

5. Dimension 3 — Cor e Negativity and Astral Connection Mapping: This checks two related things — first, whether negativity is present within the body itself (without yet identifying its source, such as pitru or black magic); second, how many of a participant's subtle bodies ("sookshm sharir") are described as scattered or "tied up" in other places rather than fully present and available — explained as diluting the ef fectiveness of a participant's own japa and ef fort, since ener gy directed by japa is described as being partly drawn toward those scattered subtle bodies before benefiting the participant's primary focus.

6. Dimension 4 — Detection of "Astral Lock" Energy Interfer ence: This checks specifically for black magic, for whether kul devta grace is present (assessed and reported only as a yes/no answer at this stage), and for dosha (af fliction) — with a distinction drawn between dosha connected to black magic (described as taking longer to clear) and dosha not connected to black magic (described as clearing more quickly); mentors are explicitly told never to disclose a participant's specific kul devta's name or details casually in this quick-checking context — that information is described as being shared only through a separate, formal ritual process treated as highly sacred.

7. Dimension 5 — Detection of Siddhi Potential and External Offering Abilities: This checks a participant's capacity to effectively direct of ferings (bhog, mantra ener gy , personal ef fort/tapasya) to their intended deity or dimension, versus having that ener gy intercepted along the way — commonly , per this teaching, by pitru, but also potentially by other wandering negativity , temple-associated spirits, or similar interference; participants with lower "grahan shakti" (receptive capacity) are described as more susceptible to this kind of interception when they perform any devotional of fering.

8. Standardizing mentor communication: Mentors are told they will be given a written script to follow when reporting these five dimensions to participants, rather than improvising their own explanations, in order to keep messaging consistent across the mentor team; they are told not to make overly specific claims (e.g., about exact past-life details or specific named doshas) beyond what the standardized script covers, while still ensuring every one of the five dimensions is at least touched on.
QUICK RULES SUMMARY

This document is an internal mentor -training walkthr ough of a new website, pr oduct structur e, and standardized "Deep Screening" (aura-checking) pr ocess — it is operational/promotional content, not a public teaching session, though it includes devotional cosmology (the five screening dimensions) consistent with this teaching's broader framework. Pricing ( ₹810) and subscription terms ar e recorded exactly as pr esented for documentary purposes and must never be presented as curr ent, live information — direct any real user asking about current pricing or enrollment to Ashaeiynn directly . The promotional video's claims (Part C) — including that shaktipat sessions can function "as a r eplacement for a meal," or that a session can r eveal a participant's kul devta's name without prior knowledge — ar e recorded strictly as this platform's own pr omotional and devotional claims, never as medical, nutritional, or independently verified fact. "Deep Screening" is explicitly described, per the mentor script itself, as NOT a medical checkup and NOT a psychological or psychic r eading — a bot must never claim to perform, replicate, or validate any form of "aura," "chakra," or "astral" screening on a real user .

This session has no separate Hinglish curated-conversation document — the content is a structured internal walkthrough and product briefing, not substantive live sangat dialogue. Spelling note: the institute's name is written "Ashaeiynn" — use this spelling consistently .
